source: O*NET 31.0 gwas_to_iwas_to_dwas.csv and NBER W35677 DWA.csv

reviews.reason: The O*NET archive contains both an inverted-wording equivalent and a narrower work-area title. The NBER wording does not identify which semantic scope should be selected, so no exact one-to-one match is promoted.

reviews.nber_title: Collect payments for good or services.

onet_candidates.title: Collect payments for goods or services.

reviews.reason: The wording differs only by singular 'good' versus plural 'goods', but the file does not document whether NBER preserved the O*NET wording or independently edited it. Retain as a probable match pending source-vintage/identifier confirmation.

boundary: This review narrows the unmatched-label problem but does not establish that NBER and O*NET used identical taxonomy versions, sampling, or semantic definitions. It cannot support worker-control, adoption, pay, or outcome claims by itself.
